Your study routine

  1. Download a pack and open Questions.md in a text editor.
  2. Work independently. Write your reasoning and test code in the stated tool.
  3. Open Worked-answers.md and compare each step.
  4. Return to the lessons for topics you need to revise.

These focused packs support revision; they do not replace the complete module outline. Examples for SQL Server, WPF and Docker need their native environment.
